g.text: System Context View: Android MCP bridge
Manages local settings and reviews protected approvals
Discovers jobs, invokes bindings and reads callback journal
Inspects approved target tree/frames and requests guarded input
Calls verified callback endpoint; authority remains separate
Connects and validates exact retained ARC profile
